reason: Twelve registered tools dispatch to implemented Tag Manager v2 handlers; simplified custom-event helper emits uppercase enum values while other API paths use lowercase values, requiring review.
exposure: All 12 tools are always listed; no conditional or read-only registration groups. Authentication occurs lazily on first call. GTM_ACCOUNT_ID filters list_accounts and checks resource account IDs for every client operation. OAuth requests readonly, edit.containers, edit.containerversions, publish, delete.containers, manage.accounts and manage.users scopes.
limitations: Static AST extraction of literal Tool registrations; no authenticated GTM operation or runtime tools/list executed.

Configuration object schemas are intentionally unrestricted upstream; no nested models, defaults, additionalProperties restrictions, or local references are declared. Handler fallbacks do not change the registered schemas.
List methods return only the first API response page and do not follow nextPageToken.

Simplified custom_event_name builds uppercase EQUALS/TEMPLATE filter values; compatibility with the live API was not verified. Generic parameter conversion supports lists of mappings, not arbitrary JSON lists or fully typed nested GTM parameters.

tools.name: gtm_list_accounts
tools.behavior: Lists accessible Tag Manager v2 accounts, filtered to GTM_ACCOUNT_ID when configured.

tools.name: gtm_list_containers
tools.description: List all containers in a GTM account
tools.behavior: Lists containers under the requested account after checking the configured account restriction.

tools.name: gtm_list_tags
tools.description: List all tags in a container workspace

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID (optional, uses default if not provided)

tools.behavior: Lists tags in the supplied workspace ID or the first returned workspace when workspace_id is absent.

tools.name: gtm_get_tag
tools.description: Get detailed configuration of a specific tag
tools.behavior: Returns the full tag resource from Tag Manager v2.

tools.name: gtm_create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag in a GTM container

firing_trigger_ids.description: List of trigger IDs that should fire this tag

tools.behavior: Creates a tag, transforming tag_config into template parameters or lists of maps and attaching firing trigger IDs.

tools.name: gtm_update_tag
tools.description: Update an existing tag in a GTM container

tag_data.description: Complete tag data object to update

tools.behavior: Passes the supplied tag_data directly to the Tag Manager v2 tags.update API.

tools.name: gtm_list_triggers
tools.description: List all triggers in a container workspace
tools.behavior: Lists trigger summaries in the supplied workspace.

tools.name: gtm_create_trigger
tools.description: Create a new trigger in a GTM container. For Custom Event triggers, use custom_event_name parameter for simplified creation.

custom_event_name.description: For Custom Event triggers: the event name to match (e.g., 'purchase', 'add_to_cart'). This automatically generates the customEventFilter.

trigger_config.description: Trigger configuration parameters (optional if using custom_event_name)

tools.behavior: Creates a trigger from supported API fields or trigger-group IDs; custom_event_name invokes a helper producing uppercase EQUALS and TEMPLATE values, unlike the lowercase enum strings in the legacy branch.

tools.name: gtm_list_variables
tools.description: List all variables in a container workspace
tools.behavior: Lists variable summaries in the supplied workspace.

tools.name: gtm_get_variable
tools.description: Get detailed configuration of a specific variable
tools.behavior: Returns the full variable resource from Tag Manager v2.

tools.name: gtm_create_variable
tools.description: Create a new variable in a GTM container

variable_type.description: Type of variable. Common types: 'c' (constant), 'v' (data layer variable), 'jsm' (javascript variable), 'u' (URL variable), 'k' (cookie)

variable_config.description: Variable configuration. For constant: {value: 'string'}, for data layer: {data_layer_name: 'name'}, for cookie: {cookie_name: 'name'}, etc.

tools.behavior: Creates variables using type-specific parameter mappings or generic template/list-of-map conversion.

tools.name: gtm_publish_container
tools.description: Create and publish a new version of a GTM container

version_notes.description: Notes describing changes in this version

tools.behavior: Creates a workspace version and publishes its returned containerVersion path; raises if that path is missing.

review.summary: Creates tags, triggers, and variables with account restrictions and publishes workspace versions.
